transcript.text: Hello, this is Shreya calling from Mumbai Bank. Am I speaking to Rahul?
Yes, this is Rahul speaking. How can I help you?
Thanks. I'm just calling about your Mumbai Bank credit card - the payment is due. By when are you planning to pay?
I already made the payment two days ago through UPI. Is there some issue with the transaction?
Okay, got it. Can you tell me the exact date and app or bank you used for the UPI payment? I'll note it down. Your payment should reflect in 2 working days.
I paid on the 3rd of June using the Google Pay app. It should be there by now.
